class news_app.models.User(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)¶

Bases: AbstractUser

Custom user model extending Django’s AbstractUser.

This model introduces role-based access control and subscription features. Users can have one of three roles: reader, editor, or journalist.

Additional Features: - Users can subscribe to publishers and journalists. - Users are automatically assigned to a Django Group based on their role.

ROLE_CHOICES = (('reader', 'Reader'), ('editor', 'Editor'), ('journalist', 'Journalist'))¶
save(*args, **kwargs)¶

Save the user instance and assign them to a Django Group based on their role.

This ensures role-based permissions can be enforced using Django’s built-in authentication and authorization system.

subscribed_journalists = 'self'¶
subscribed_publishers = 'Publisher'¶

news_app.serializers module¶

class news_app.serializers.ArticleSerializer(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)¶

Bases: ModelSerializer

Serializer for the Article model.

Handles conversion between Article instances and JSON, and ensures that sensitive fields such as ‘author’ and ‘approved’ cannot be manually set by clients.

The author is automatically assigned based on the authenticated user. Articles are created as unapproved by default and can only be approved by editors.

news_app.tests module¶

class news_app.tests.ArticleAPITests(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)¶

Bases: APITestCase

Test suite for Article API endpoints.

This class verifies correct behaviour of the API, including: - Role-based permissions (reader, journalist, editor) - Article creation and deletion - Visibility of approved articles - Subscription-based filtering - External API trigger on approval

setUp()¶

Set up test data for all test cases.

Creates three users with different roles (journalist, editor, reader) and an initial unapproved article authored by the journalist.

test_approval_triggers_api_call(mock_post)¶

Verify that approving an article triggers an external API call.

Expected behaviour:

  • requests.post is called once when an article is approved

test_editor_can_delete_article()¶

Verify that an editor can delete an article.

Expected result:

  • HTTP 204 No Content

test_journalist_can_create_article()¶

Verify that a journalist can successfully create an article.

Expected result:

  • HTTP 201 Created

test_journalist_cannot_delete_article()¶

Verify that a journalist cannot delete an article.

Expected result:

  • HTTP 403 Forbidden

test_only_approved_articles_visible()¶

Verify that only approved articles are returned in the API.

Expected behaviour:

  • Unapproved articles are hidden

  • Approved articles are visible

test_reader_cannot_create_article()¶

Verify that a reader is forbidden from creating an article.

Expected result:

  • HTTP 403 Forbidden

test_reader_gets_only_subscribed_articles()¶

Verify that a reader only receives articles from subscribed journalists.

Expected behaviour:

  • Only articles from subscribed users are returned
